# Third-party notices

This directory contains the core and fluid modules adapted from [Three.js Particle Fluids](https://github.com/dgreenheck/threejs-particle-fluids) by Daniel Greenheck. Its MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

Three.js retains its own MIT license, included in `public/licenses/three.txt` at the project root. Research references remain in the source comments. Upstream demo assets are not included.
